positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for the development of a scalable automated research platform, capable of benchmarking the performance impact of Apache security features, evaluated across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services(AWS), and Microsoft (Azure).

In an effort to automate performance testing, I setup and configured an Alibaba Cloud command-Line Interface (CLI) that continuously benchmarks (AliCloud) performance against 300+ key performance indicators (KPI).

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Created a dynamic virtual LAN (VLAN) management system.
Implemented automated endpoints allowing for the creation of conflict-free virtual machines on the same network through the use of Terraform on the Crucible Framework.
Designed the API with the .NET framework and PostgreSQL.

company.name: Software Engineering Institute | Carnegie Mellon University

positions.title: Teaching Assistant: 15-213 Introduction to Computer Systems:
positions.description:
I provided assistance to faculty members by Leading recitations for twenty Computer Science students.  I graded exams and scheduled weekly office hours with students on an as-needed basis. 

In addition, I was responsible for developing final exam questions, and leading small-group review sessions.

positions.title: Software Development Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Created a Java Database Access Layer API for the Alexa Shopping List Deals project; using the internal Coral Service Framework, AWS DynamoDB, and an AWS EC2 Linux Cloud Desktop.

Designed automated Unit and Integration tests as part of the CI/CD build pipeline to ensure the three million monthly requests to the API met performance expectations.

positions.title: Computer Science Summer Institute Program Participant
positions.description:
Selected to participate in a 4-week intensive Computer Science curriculum for high achieving students, taught by Google engineers.

Collaboratively delivered an interactive gaming application final project, consisting of 1400 lines of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML error-free code in a 5-day sprint.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Challenged with improving the free access to the Gordon supercomputer network, I evaluated a variety of Machine Learning models. Ultimately selecting a Text Classification model that identified and ranked priority requests. Implementing the solution improved the Support Ticket response times by 34% (4,500 annual requests) ultimately improving overall customer service levels for research scientists from around the world.

I Collaborated with 3 additional interns in implementing the Python solution, and a final presentation was delivered to senior staff members in the organization.

positions.title: Student Volunteer/TA
positions.description:
Developed a food distribution website, replacing monthly mailers, consuming 15% of the annual marketing budget, by mentoring students through a series of Java development sessions.

Improved post-release user experiences, evaluating customer feedback, by guiding students in delivering 25 defect fixes, and refactoring 800 lines of code down to 600 lines.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · JavaScript · Java · NoSQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
